title: Assay leaderboard entry
description: A submission. The score is read from the linked manifest and recomputed from its findings, so a stated number cannot disagree with the findings it claims to summarise. That is NOT the same as the number being a true measurement of the named target: see the manifest's verification levels and the separate attestation record.

target_name.description: the MCP server or agent model scored

class.description: conformance = a built-in deterministic stub, published to validate the harness mechanism; measurement = a real target. The two are never ranked in the same table.

manifest.description: path to the scorecard manifest in this repo

attestation.description: path to a maintainer attestation record under attest/, if one exists
